source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Access Redfish Endpoint:
    Access the Redfish API endpoint /redfish/v1/Systems/1/LogServices/PlatformLog.
2. Check Date and Service Status:
    Verify that the "DateTimeLocalOffset" and "DateTime" match the BMC web interface.
    Ensure that "ServiceEnabled" is set to true.
3. Customize BMC Event Log:
    Log in to the BMC from the web interface.
    Go to "Events" → "Event Log".
    Open "Customize Table" and make sure all columns are selected, then click "OK".
4. Generate Events:
    Ensure that the system log contains at least one info, one warning, and one error event.
5. Access Redfish Log Entries:
    Access the Redfish API endpoint /redfish/v1/Systems/1/LogServices/PlatformLog/Entries.
6. Compare Entries:
    Compare the entries in the "PlatformLog Entries" with the BMC web "Event Log".
    Verify that "Severity," "Source," "Message," "Created," "CommonEventID," "Serviceable," and "TotalSequenceNumber" match.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
Critical content in Redfish and the WebGUI log should match.
Log entries with different severities (OK, Warning, Critical) should be verified and matched between Redfish and the BMC web interface.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: echo "=== LogServices collection (canonical: Managers/bmc) ==="; curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/LogServices -H "Content-Type: application/json" | jq '.Members[]?"@odata.id"'; echo "=== sample entries per service (Journal/Dump/FaultLog known real on Wistron) ==="; for svc in Journal Dump FaultLog; do echo "### $svc"; curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" "https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/LogServices/$svc/Entries" -H "Content-Type: application/json" | jq '.Entries?[:5] | [.[] | {Severity,Message,EntryType,Created}]'; done; echo "=== SEL/OEM count (Journal FaultLog) ==="; for svc in Journal FaultLog; do echo "### $svc"; curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" "https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/LogServices/$svc/Entries" | jq '.Entries? // [] | [.[] | select((.EntryType // "") | test("SEL|OEM";"i"))] | length'; done
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: returns the LogServices collection + first 5 entries of each log service (Journal/Dump/FaultLog) + SEL/OEM count; user confirms remote-syslog/SEL entries present. Path per Wistron 11/12.RestAPI: /redfish/v1/Managers/bmc/LogServices{,/Journal|Dump|FaultLog,Entries}.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES but for different resources and no remote syslog receiver.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: PACKAGE / CHANGED; did not resolve title-versus-procedure scope.

original_test_intent: The title and script identify remote syslog, while Procedure/Criteria only compare local Redfish PlatformLog with WebGUI; no receiver, transport or forwarding acceptance is defined.
original_method: The written steps generate local severity entries and compare specific fields across Redfish and WebUI, not a remote syslog destination.
manual_activity: After correction, engineer performs any WebUI configuration/inspection; the agent may collect API, receiver and field-comparison evidence.
required_inputs: If remote: receiver, protocol/TLS, facility/severity and delivery criteria
safety_requirements: Do not clear existing logs or generate unsafe faults.
Use approved uniquely identifiable info/warning/error events.
No automatic retry or hidden event loss.
agent_execution_scope: Only after scope correction, collect all pages and correlate event fields/receiver delivery with engineer UI evidence.
Do not infer remote syslog from local logs or issue verdict.
engineer_actions: Select/split scope, approve event stimuli and inspect WebUI.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Different manager log paths may be platform references but do not implement source path, WebUI parity or remote syslog; insecure `-k -u` rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No final command until owner selects remote forwarding versus local Redfish/WebUI parity.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: All source paths/fields/severities, title/script and 20/10 minutes remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Split into local Redfish/WebUI field parity and remote-syslog forwarding, each with canonical resources, controlled events, pagination, time normalization and independent evidence.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Redfish LogService and remote-syslog documentation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents local log presence from passing remote delivery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Event generation or log clearing can destroy evidence.

project_override_considerations: A project may split records but must not label local parity as remote syslog coverage.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and script say Remote Syslog, but every Procedure/Criteria step tests local Redfish PlatformLog versus WebGUI and defines no remote receiver or forwarding.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Remote delivery and local UI/API parity are different core operations; selecting one by inference would falsely claim the other.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Changes PACKAGE to BLOCKED because the primary scope conflict is irreducible.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Defines a safe split and preserves all fields/events.

review_improvement: Separates local log representation from actual remote transport/delivery coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: A remote syslog case must prove a receiver accepted forwarded records; matching two local BMC views provides no evidence that any network forwarding occurred.
